# Screenshot Plan — VulnSpeed

## Screenshots

### 1. Real-Time Inline Detection
**Title:** Vulnerabilities Highlighted as You Type
**What to capture:** A Java or Python file with inline vulnerability highlights — red/yellow underlines with severity icons in the gutter. Show at least 2-3 different vulnerability types (e.g., SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credential).

### 2. Auto-Fix Suggestion
**Title:** One-Click Auto-Fix with Alt+Enter
**What to capture:** The Alt+Enter quick-fix popup on a highlighted vulnerability showing the suggested fix description. Show the before state with the vulnerability and the fix option in the popup menu.

### 3. VulnSpeed Tool Window
**Title:** Security Dashboard with Severity Breakdown
**What to capture:** The VulnSpeed tool window at the bottom showing a list of vulnerabilities with columns for severity, CWE/OWASP classification, file, line, and description. Include statistics or a severity chart.

### 4. Project Scan Results
**Title:** Full Project Scan with Vulnerability Inventory
**What to capture:** The results of a project-wide scan showing all findings grouped by file or severity. Include the total count and breakdown by severity level.

### 5. File Scan Context Menu
**Title:** Scan Any File with Right-Click
**What to capture:** The editor context menu showing "Scan File with VulnSpeed" option. Show the right-click menu on a source file.

### 6. Multi-Language Support
**Title:** 7 Languages — Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and More
**What to capture:** A split or tiled view showing vulnerability detection working in two different languages (e.g., Java file and Python file side by side) with inline highlights in both.

### 7. Settings Page
**Title:** Configure Scanning Preferences
**What to capture:** The Settings → Tools → VulnSpeed page showing toggle for real-time scanning, max file size, auto-fix settings, and license management section.

### 8. Compliance Report (Pro)
**Title:** Generate SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS Reports
**What to capture:** A generated compliance report showing vulnerability findings mapped to compliance frameworks with pass/fail indicators.
